scope: Actual browser GPU output with native GDI fonts: SBMS mathematical reproduction versus final; not production SBMS execution, codec evaluation or FPS benchmark.
layout: One unscaled RGBA8 atlas, top-down: eight CT scenarios by two sides. Six complete rows per panel with 32-pixel slots; 8-pixel gaps. Source offset (0,0) only; geometric row phases are recorded separately. Grayscale and all three source offsets are quantified in the main report.
